lead: Competitive intelligence signals across EFB, flight planning, and dispatch vendors show active product development and customer adoption wins, with IFS securing LCC carriers like MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet.

insights.title: IFS Secures LCC Contracts for EFBOne
insights.finding: IFS secured multiple customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, including deployments and selections by LCCs MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet.
insights.aviation_context: MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet are classified as low-cost carriers (LCCs).
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility reflects publicized announcements rather than full market share.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight and Dispatch Features
insights.finding: Jeppesen rolled out multiple feature changes and product enhancements, including FliteDeck Pro version 5.3 with Enroute Profile View and ForeFlight Airflow capabilities.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight is widely utilized across commercial and business aviation for EFB workflows.
insights.caveat: Feature captures are based on press releases and announcements.

insights.title: Aviobook Signs Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales (Aviobook) signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to deploy the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a network carrier connecting Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems successfully implemented its Lido Flight 4D flight planning and digital briefing solution for Kenya Airways.
insights.aviation_context: Lido Flight 4D supports flight planning and operational dispatch workflows.
insights.caveat: Implementation timeline is tied to vendor announcements.

insights.title: Navblue Expands TransNusa Partnership
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by adopting Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ to integrate flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Skywise Core X2 and Fleet Performance+ link flight operations with aircraft health monitoring.
insights.caveat: Marked as the first agreement for these specific products in Indonesia.
